description.short_caption: Skin lesion with central necrosis and surrounding erythema on the chest near the areola.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a skin lesion on the chest near the areola. The lesion has a central necrotic area with a dark eschar, surrounded by erythema and mild swelling. The areola appears hyperpigmented and is adjacent to the lesion. A measurement scale is included for size reference.
visible_findings: central necrotic lesion with dark eschar

description.short_caption: Three ulcerative skin lesions with central necrosis and surrounding erythema.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows three distinct ulcerative lesions on the skin of the back. Each lesion has a central area of necrosis with a dark eschar surrounded by erythematous borders. The lesions are evenly spaced, and a ruler is included in the image for scale, indicating the approximate size of the ulcers. The surrounding skin appears otherwise unremarkable.
